name: OGRE DRIVE
text: +3 Hype if the call has a 4th or 5th in it.

art.flavor: Mid-heavy grit, loud enough to wake a bridge.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: SWAMP FUZZ
text: +1 Hype for each note you play on the three low strings.

art.flavor: Thick, sputtering fuzz from somewhere below the waterline.

name: GLASS CHORUS
text: +8 Tone for each note you play at fret 7 or higher.

art.flavor: Two voices a hair out of step, like light through old window glass.
art.label: #0E2A2A

name: ECHO WELL
text: Your last note scores its Tone a second time.

art.flavor: Drop a note in and wait for it to come back up.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: WYRM WAH
text: +2 Hype for each half step or minor 3rd in the call.

art.flavor: Every note you pick makes it bark.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: MOON OCTAVER
text: Your first note scores triple Tone.

art.flavor: Casts a shadow an octave below everything you play.
art.label: #241A40

name: CATHEDRAL VERB
text: +10 Tone for each Replay you still have.

art.flavor: A stone hall around every note. Save your replays and it rings brighter.
art.label: #9A9AAA

name: DRAGON STACK
text: x1.5 Hype if every note landed in the groove.

art.flavor: A whole wall of amplifiers in one box. It rewards clean timing.
art.label: #1A0606

name: IRON COMP
text: +1 Hype, and your groove window is twice as wide.

art.flavor: Squeezes every note flat and even, and forgives loose timing.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: GOBLIN SCREAMER
text: +2 Hype for each 3rd in the call.

art.flavor: A mid-hump screamer that sits right on top of the band.
art.label: #E8F0D8

name: BASILISK DIST
text: x1.5 Hype if the call has 4 or more notes.

art.flavor: Tight, hard clipping. One look and your notes turn to stone.
art.label: #1A1618

name: HORNET FUZZ
text: +1 Hype for each note you play on the three high strings.

art.flavor: Buzzes an octave above whatever you feed it.
art.label: #1A1408

name: TAPE WYVERN
text: Every note scores half its Tone again.

art.flavor: Warbly repeats off a loop of old tape, a little slower each time.
art.label: #3A2A1A

name: SLAPBACK SPUR
text: +6 Tone for each note in the Pocket.

art.flavor: One quick bounce off the back wall of a honky-tonk.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: PHASE PHANTOM
text: +3 Hype if the call only climbs, or only falls.

art.flavor: A slow swirl, like something moving behind the amp.
art.label: #2A1206

name: TREMOR TIDE
text: +1 Hype for each note in the groove.

art.flavor: Volume that rises and falls like the tide, in time with the band.
art.label: #E8F4F4

name: ROTARY SPIRIT
text: +0.5 Hype for each true call in a row. A miss resets it.

art.flavor: A spinning horn in a wooden cabinet. The longer it spins, the wilder it gets.
art.label: #F4E6C8

name: ENVELOPE OWL
text: +5 Tone for each note higher than the one before it.

art.flavor: A filter that opens its eyes wider the harder you pick.
art.label: #1A1030

name: HARMONY TWINS
text: +1 Hype for each different note name in the call.

art.flavor: Two voices a third apart, always singing together.
art.label: #FFF0F6

name: SPRING TANK
text: +6 Tone for each Replay you have used tonight.

art.flavor: Surf-shop drip. Loves it when you listen twice.
art.label: #E8F0F8

name: SHIMMER HALO
text: x2 Tone on a HOT call. Otherwise +20 Tone.

art.flavor: Reverb with an octave glowing above it. Brightest on the calls you once missed.
art.label: #2A2440

name: TROLL BOOST
text: +10 Tone.

art.flavor: No tricks. Just louder, and a little meaner.
art.label: #F0ECD8

name: LICH LOOPER
text: Gains +3 Tone for every true call this run. Now +0 Tone.

art.flavor: It remembers every true call you play, and plays them all back at once.
art.label: #0E0612

name: GRAVE GATE
text: +2 Hype if you did not replay this call.

art.flavor: Shuts the hum out cold. Rewards the confident.
art.label: #D8D8DC
